name: chunk_id
description: blake2b-256 hex of source_fqn:row_digest:chunk_index; deterministic identity key. WRITE_APPEND means duplicate rows are possible across retried/racing runs; readers dedupe by keying on row_digest.

name: source_pk
description: Primary-key column -> value map for the source row; NULL when no PK declared.

name: row_digest
description: SHA-256 of the canonical-encoded source row (row_doc) or of {column,value} (deduped free_text_col value chunks).

name: reference_digest
description: SHA-256 over the whole reference sample (ADR 0005); idempotency/lookup key.

name: chunk_index
description: 0 for row_doc and for deduped free_text_col value chunks (identity carried by row_digest).

name: chunk_text
description: The exact string that was embedded.

name: embedder_version
description: Embedder weight version, e.g. 'v1'. (embedder_id, embedder_version) pins the vector space.

name: embedding
description: L2-normalized embedding (dim fixed per embedder; 384 for bge-small-en-v1.5).

name: metadata
description: Free-form extras, e.g. {"column": "notes"} for free_text_col chunks.

name: created_at
description: Row write time (UTC). DAY partition key.
